answers.1: Yellow and Green — both are people-oriented and friendly, so they connect easily on a social level.
answers.2: Red and Blue — both are task-oriented, so they complement each other well in getting work done.
answers.8: Green — steadiness and predictability are Green's hallmark (Blue is a close runner-up).
answers.9: Red — results matter more than the rulebook.
answers.10: Red — willing to take risks and try new approaches if it gets results.
answers.11: Green — takes criticism personally and dwells on it.
answers.12: Yellow — disorganized, but with a great network and knows exactly who to ask.
answers.16: Red — makes quick, snap judgments about people.
answers.17: All four together — a balanced team of Red, Yellow, Green and Blue.
answers.19: Yellow — the idea person, quickest to pick up and run with new ideas.
answers.20: Blue — the perfectionist who delegates but doesn't trust others' quality and redoes it himself.
answers.23: No single answer — this depends entirely on the individual's own social circle.
